title: Vector generator CLI freshness/check tests fail in group-writable workspaces — same atomic_json parent-refusal class as rys8, wider surface
description: Found during the 5rfl round's full-suite gate (worker5). python/tests/test_vector_generator_cli.py::test_packets_timing_check_is_byte_exact_and_read_only / test_authenticated_dio_check_is_byte_exact_and_read_only / test_hash32_check_is_byte_exact_and_read_only, plus python/tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py::test_committed_ipv6_address_vectors_match_stdlib_generator, python/tests/test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py::test_committed_icmpv6_vectors_match_stdlib_generator, python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_all_vector_documents_have_explicit_schema_policy (some parametrized; 9 failed total) all fail on a PRISTINE stash run — pre-existing, not caused by this round. Most invoke generate_*.py --check, which exits 2 'cannot safely read ...: atomic JSON parent directory is unsafe' in group-writable checkouts (umask 002 hosts whose group has members beyond the owner, e.g. this host's 'mark' group containing langwei — atomic_json now correctly refuses those after rys8's verified-UPG tightening). Fix direction: extend the rys8 pattern — a shared helper/test fixture that maps the generator's rc==2 'cannot safely read' refusal to a loudly-reasoned pytest.skip (staleness rc==1 still fails) — or centralize the check invocation so each generator test does not hand-roll subprocess asserts. Also re-check test_edhoc_responder.py::test_failed_message_3_is_removed_and_fresh_handshake_succeeds (passed in isolation on clean and current trees during triage but failed under full-suite load — likely a timing flake, separate defect). discovered-from rys8.
